title: PSID 2023 documents a viable material, work, time, care, health, and household-room backbone
source_unit: PSID 2023 Family File user guide, file-structure documentation, and official codebook field audit
geography: United States; PSID family and person panel structure

observations.period: 2023 Family File documentation release; user guide released 2025

time_pressure_field.unit: frequency of feeling rushed or pressed for time

health_fields.unit: general health and change versus two years earlier

observations.method: Official user-guide and codebook field audit; documented availability is kept separate from an executed data extract.
observations.uncertainty: The file base is not the final analytic denominator; routing, family/person unit, missingness, imputation, attrition, and weights require separate checks.
observations.subgroup: 2023 PSID Family File Reference Person and family-level documentation surfaces.
observations.counterinterpretation: A documented field may not be comparable or sufficiently populated across 2019, 2021, and 2023 after merge and universe checks.

observations.period: 2023 Family File codebook; field and coding audit

care_and_time_fields.unit: personal care, shopping, child care, and time-pressure fields

material_room_fields.unit: income, wealth, home insurance, and utility expenditure fields

cross_wave_concept_mapping.value: BC60A, F1A, and F1K concepts retained in 2019, 2021, and 2023

observations.method: Field-label, question-text, universe, and code-category inspection in the official 2023 codebook.
observations.uncertainty: Generated and imputed measures require a separate estimate-level audit; codebook availability does not reveal cross-wave cell size.
observations.subgroup: Reference Person and family expenditure/material fields with documented routing and accuracy categories.
observations.counterinterpretation: The same named concept can have different universe or coding behavior across waves.

denominator.unit: planned PSID public-use packages: 2019, 2021, 2023 Family Files and 1968–2023 Cross-year Individual File

observations.method: Official package-page inspection plus unauthenticated route recheck; access condition is recorded separately from data absence.
observations.uncertainty: The workspace cannot establish whether an authorized account holder can download the packages; the redirect is not evidence that the files are unavailable.
observations.counterinterpretation: A registered user who accepts the Conditions of Use may obtain the packages through the same official routes.

related_sources.claim: Defines the proposed 2019/2021/2023 merge, fields, quality gates, and first comparison cells.
Tracks the prior PSID acquisition and access boundary.

boundary: This record documents PSID field availability and panel structure; it does not contain estimates, a valid cross-wave merge, a dated trigger, causal attribution, trust/action outcomes, or an end-to-end household-to-political result.
